en:
Welcome to Mario Forever: Maker Party!

Mario Forever: Maker Party is a game with DIY features. Please ensure the following during gameplay:
· The levels you create shall comply with public order and good morals, and must not contain inappropriate, illegal or non-compliant content such as violence, pornography, vulgarity, discrimination or horror.
· Abide by local laws and regulations.
· Do not use the level creation function to produce or spread malicious code, viruses, or design malicious levels that may induce device malfunctions or information leakage for players.

Level Storage Notice
For level reuse purposes, the levels you create will be automatically cached to other players’ local devices during online gameplay; similarly, levels created by other players will also be automatically cached to your local device.
zh:
欢迎游玩 Mario Forever: Maker Party！

Mario Forever: Maker Party 是有 DIY 属性的游戏，因此，在游玩过程中，请确保：
· 创作的关卡内容符合公序良俗，不得包含暴力、色情、低俗、歧视、恐怖等不良及违法违规内容
· 遵守当地法律法规
· 不得利用关卡创作功能制作、传播恶意代码、病毒，或设计诱导玩家设备故障、信息泄露的恶意关卡

关卡存储说明：
· 考虑到关卡复用，你创作的关卡在联机游玩过程中会被其他玩家自动缓存至其本地设备；同样地，其他玩家创作的关卡也会被自动缓存至你的本地设备。
